name: restx-capacitor
description: RestX — contador de descanso para academia, web/PWA + Android + iOS via Capacitor.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:add:android: npx cap add android && npm run setup:native && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:add:ios: npx cap add ios && npm run setup:native && npx cap sync ios
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npm run setup:native && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npm run setup:native && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
